title: Status effects
content:
# Status effects

# Introduction

Status effects are modifiers you can attain either on a timer, or more rarely, as a semi-permanent passive effect.
Additional sources of status effects, not listed below, include Forsaken powers and Mead.

## List of status effects

• Effect name: Berserk | Typical source: Bear Set bonus | Effects: +30% Health regeneration +15% Stamina regeneration Slightly weak (+25% damage taken) vs Blunt, Slash and Pierce +10% Slash damage +10% Chop damage

• Effect name: Burning | Typical source: Fire damage | Effects: Damage over 5 seconds.The timer of the Wet Effect expires 60x faster. | Notes: The flames covering the character makes them a nice source of light for a few seconds.

• Effect name: Cold | Typical source: Being out at night without a heat source. | Effects: Health regen: -50%Stamina regen: -25% Eitr regen: -25% | Notes: Lasts until player is either near a heat source or until night ends.

• Effect name: Corpse run | Typical source: Collecting all items from a grave. | Effects: Jump stamina usage: -75%Run stamina usage: -75%Very resistant (0.25x) VS Blunt, Slash, Pierce +5 health per second+150 carry weight | Notes: 50 second duration

• Effect name: Dvergr heal | Typical source: Support Dvergr mage | Effects: Heals 400 health over 4 seconds.

• Effect name: Dvergr power | Typical source: Support Dvergr mage | Effects: Boosts damage by 20% for 20 seconds.

• Effect name: Encumbered | Typical source: When exceeding carrying capacity. | Effects: Disables running, jumping, blocking, dodging and stamina recovery, while reducing walk speed to that of crouching. | Notes: Carrying capacity can be increased by Corpse Run and with a Megingjord.

• Effect name: Feather fall | Typical source: Feather cape effect | Effects: Limit fall speed: 5m/sFall damage: -100%Jump stamina usage: -20%

• Effect name: Fenris blessing | Typical source: Fenris Set bonus | Effects: Resistant (0.5x) VS FireFists +15 | Notes: Permanent only while entire set is equipped.

• Effect name: Fire | Typical source: Campfire, working Smelter, working Charcoal Kiln | Effects: The timer of the Wet Effect expires 10x faster.Removes Cold and reduces Freezing Effect.

• Effect name: Fishing hat | Typical source: Fishing hat effect | Effects: Fishing +20Swim +20

• Effect name: Freezing | Typical source: When in the Mountain biome. When fighting against Moder. During Drake event. | Effects: Health regen: -100%Stamina regen: -60%Eitr regen: -60%1 damage per secondResistant (0.5x) VS Fire | Notes: Not applied when having Frost resistance, having shelter or while under the Fire effect.

• Effect name: Frost | Typical source: Frost damage | Effects: Up to -100% movement speed. | Notes: Speed penalty decays exponentially over the duration of the status effect. Stacks of Frost affected by health lost.

• Effect name: Harpooned | Typical source: Abyssal harpoon | Effects: Pulls the character toward the harpooner. | Notes: Bosses cannot be harpooned.

• Effect name: Immobilized | Typical source: Trap, weapons using Jade such as the Klossen, Nidhögg the Primal, Primal Berserkir axes, Primal Slayer, Splitnir the Primal, Staff of the Wild, Root (Staff of the Wild), and Root Fang. | Effects: Prevents targeted creature's movement for 10 seconds. | Notes: Creature may still perform attacks that can be executed from a static position, and The Queen may still relocate with her burrow ability.

• Effect name: Improved archery | Typical source: Root Armor set bonus | Effects: Bows skill +15 points | Notes: Permanent only while entire set is equipped.

• Effect name: Lightning | Typical source: Lightning damage | Effects: Visual effect only, lasts for 3 seconds.

• Effect name: Magic barrier | Typical source: Staff of Protection | Effects: Blocks 200-700 damage (depending oncaster's skill level). | Notes: Surrounds the character in a transparent, reflective red orb.Duration depends on weapon quality.

• Effect name: Megingjord | Typical source: Megingjord effect | Effects: Max carry weight +150

• Effect name: No skill drain | Typical source: Dying. | Effects: No XP loss | Notes: 10 minute duration, resets timer if the player dies again.

• Effect name: Poison | Typical source: Poison damage | Effects: Damage over time. | Notes: Poisoned characters are surrounded by a green smoky effect, slightly luminous.Resistance to Poison halves both the damage done by poison and its duration.

• Effect name: Feeling sick | Typical source: Bukeperries, Rotten meat | Effects: For 15 seconds, disables health and stamina regen, and halves movement speed; every 2 seconds, deals 1 damage and undoes one consumed Food.

• Effect name: Rested | Typical source: Resting effect for 20s, sleeping in a bed. | Effects: Health regen: +50%Stamina regen: +100%XP gain: +50%Eitr regen: +100%

• Effect name: Resting | Typical source: Sheltered or while under the Fire effect. | Effects: Health regen: +200%Stamina regen: +300%Eitr regen: +300% | Notes: Leads to the Rested effect within 20s.

• Effect name: Shelter | Typical source: Under roof and having 80% cover. | Effects: Protects from rain and freezing. Enables resting.

• Effect name: Slimed | Typical source: The Queen's spit attack | Effects: Movement speed -50%Very weak (2.0x) VS Fire

• Effect name: Smoked | Typical source: Standing inside a cloud of smoke. | Effects: 2 damage per second | Notes: Damages without sound cue.

• Effect name: Sneaky | Typical source: All four pieces of the Troll armor set are equipped. | Effects: +15 Sneak skill | Notes: Does not exceed the skill cap of 100.

• Effect name: Tarred | Typical source: Walking into a tar pit. Being hit by a growth. | Effects: -50% movement speed. Very weak (2.0x) VS fire. | Notes: Tarred characters are surrounded by black tar particles that seem to follow the character's movements.

• Effect name: Vilebone Wrath | Typical source: Vilebone Set bonus | Effects: +20% Health regen +40% Stamina regen Slightly weak (+25%) vs Blunt, Slash and Pierce +20% Blunt +20% Pierce

• Effect name: Wet | Typical source: Caught in the rain. Immersed in water. | Effects: Health regen: -25%Stamina regen: -15%Eitr regen: -15%Resistant (0.5x) VS FireWeak (1.5x) VS FrostWeak (1.5x) VS Lightning

• Effect name: Wind run | Typical source: Asksvin cloak | Effects: Run faster when running with the direction of the wind.

• Effect name: Wishbone | Typical source: Wishbone effect | Effects: Pings when near hidden objects.

• Effect name: Wisplight | Typical source: Wisplight effect | Effects: Dispels mist within a 10m radius around the character.

## List of non-player status effects

• Effect name: GD Heal | Typical source: Greydwarf shaman | Effects: Heals 20 health over 4 seconds. | Notes: Non-player creatures only

• Effect name: GoblinShaman_shield | Typical source: Fuling shaman | Effects: Blocks up to 100 damage over 40 seconds | Notes: Non-player creatures only

• Effect name: Spirit | Typical source: Spirit damage | Effects: Damage over 3 seconds. | Notes: Non-player creatures only
